_comment: Gazetteer for scripts/import_local.py. Photos are labelled with the nearest place within radius km (default 1.5). Optional after/before (HH:MM) restrict a place by time of day, for spots that share a location. Coordinates are approximate. Shown in the lightbox mini map: kind (icon), blurb, url (website), q (Google Maps search; defaults to "<name>, Hawaii", "coords" pins the coordinates).

places.name: Horizon Guest House
places.blurb: Four-suite B&B on 40 acres of pasture on Mauna Loa's slope above Hōnaunau, with an ocean-view pool.

places.name: Don's Mai Tai Bar
places.blurb: Oceanfront bar at the Royal Kona Resort in Kailua-Kona.
places.q: Don's Mai Tai Bar, Royal Kona Resort

places.name: Makāula-ʻOʻoma Trail
places.blurb: Upland forest above Kona, and the trip's first birding walk.

places.name: Kuleana Rum Shack
places.blurb: Kuleana Rum Works' restaurant and bar at Queens' MarketPlace in Waikoloa. Rum flights and ahi poke.

places.name: Puʻukoholā Heiau
places.blurb: Temple built by Kamehameha I in 1790–91; a prophecy said building it would let him unite the islands.

places.name: Puakō Petroglyphs
places.blurb: Thousands of petroglyphs carved into pāhoehoe lava, a short walk from Holoholokai Beach Park.

places.name: Kalahuipuaʻa fishponds
places.blurb: Ancient Hawaiian fishponds on the Mauna Lani shoreline.

places.name: Mauna Lani
places.blurb: The Mauna Lani resort on the Kohala Coast. Sunset drinks on the beach before dinner at CanoeHouse.

places.name: CanoeHouse
places.blurb: Oceanfront restaurant at Mauna Lani, open since 1989.

places.name: Hula Daddy
places.blurb: 100% Kona coffee farm and tasting room in upcountry Holualoa.

places.name: Drive to Waimea
places.blurb: Climbing from the Kona side up into Waimea's ranch country.

places.name: Paniolo Adventures
places.blurb: Horseback rides on a working ranch in the Kohala Mountains.

places.name: Kohala Mountain Road
places.blurb: Highway 250 between Hāwī and Waimea, through ranch land along the Kohala Mountains.

places.name: Merriman's
places.blurb: Peter Merriman's Waimea flagship, a pioneer of Hawaiʻi Regional Cuisine.

places.name: Kealakekua Bay
places.blurb: Marine life conservation district and snorkel spot, home to the Captain Cook monument.

places.name: Noio
places.blurb: 12-seat omakase counter at the Four Seasons Hualālai.

places.name: South Point
places.blurb: Ka Lae, the southernmost point of the United States.

places.name: Volcano Village Lodge
places.blurb: Rainforest lodge in Volcano Village, just outside the national park.

places.name: Mauna Kea visitor station
places.blurb: Visitor station at about 9,200 ft on Mauna Kea, where we stargazed after the summit.

places.name: Mauna Kea summit
places.blurb: The 13,803 ft summit, ringed by observatories. Sunset above the clouds.

places.name: Kīlauea caldera
places.blurb: Kīlauea's summit caldera and Halemaʻumaʻu crater, in Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park.

places.name: Volcano House
places.blurb: Historic hotel on the rim of Kīlauea caldera. Lunch with a crater view.

places.name: Volcano
places.blurb: Volcano Village and the ʻōhiʻa rainforest around it.

places.name: Puʻu ʻŌʻō Trail
places.blurb: Saddle Road trail through native-forest kīpuka. Birding with Jack Jeffrey.

places.name: Palila Discovery Trail
places.blurb: Māmane forest on Mauna Kea's slope, habitat of the endangered palila.

places.name: Lehua Restaurant
places.blurb: Restaurant in the ʻImiloa Astronomy Center on the UH Hilo campus.

places.name: Chain of Craters Road
places.blurb: Road from Kīlauea's summit down to the sea across decades of lava flows.

places.name: Hōlei Sea Arch
places.blurb: Lava sea arch at the end of Chain of Craters Road.

places.name: ʻAkaka Falls
places.blurb: 442-ft waterfall in ʻAkaka Falls State Park near Honomū.

places.name: Hawaiʻi Tropical Botanical Garden
places.blurb: Rainforest garden in a valley on the Onomea Bay coast, north of Hilo.

places.name: Hilo Honu Inn
places.blurb: Hilo B&B with Japanese-style suites.

places.name: The Seaside
places.blurb: Hilo seafood restaurant on a 30-acre fishpond, run by the Nakagawa family since the 1920s.
places.q: The Seaside Restaurant and Aqua Farm, Hilo

places.name: Royal Hawaiian
places.blurb: The "Pink Palace of the Pacific", on Waikīkī Beach since 1927.

places.name: Mai Tai Bar
places.blurb: The Royal Hawaiian's oceanfront bar, steps from the sand.

places.name: natuRe
places.blurb: Farm-to-table French tasting menus in Waikīkī.

places.name: Bishop Museum
places.blurb: Hawaiʻi's museum of natural and cultural history, founded in 1889.

places.name: La Mariana Sailing Club
places.blurb: Old-school tiki bar at a Keʻehi Lagoon marina.

places.name: Skull & Crown Trading Co.
places.blurb: Horror-tinged Chinatown tiki bar with one of the biggest rum collections in the islands.

places.name: ʻAiea Loop Trail
places.blurb: Ridge loop in Keaīwa Heiau State Recreation Area, on the hunt for ʻamakihi and ʻelepaio.

places.name: Hoʻomaluhia Botanical Garden
places.blurb: Garden and reservoir at the foot of the Koʻolau cliffs in Kāneʻohe.

places.name: Nuʻuanu Pali Lookout
places.blurb: Windward cliffs where Kamehameha's forces won the 1795 Battle of Nuʻuanu.

places.name: Puʻu ʻUalakaʻa
places.blurb: State wayside on Round Top, looking across Honolulu to Diamond Head.

places.name: Helena's Hawaiian Food
places.blurb: Kalihi Hawaiian-food institution, serving since 1946.

places.name: House Without A Key
places.blurb: The Halekulani's oceanfront terrace, with hula under the kiawe tree at sunset.

places.name: Hanauma Bay
places.blurb: Nature preserve in a volcanic crater, and Oʻahu's best-known snorkeling bay.

places.name: Lānaʻi Lookout
places.blurb: Lookout on the Kaʻiwi coast; on clear days you can see Lānaʻi and Molokaʻi.

places.name: White terns at UH Mānoa
places.blurb: White terns (manu-o-Kū), Honolulu's official bird, nest in the campus trees.

places.name: Aliʻi Fish Market
places.blurb: Poke counter on South King Street in Mōʻiliʻili. Bomb poke.

places.name: ʻIolani Palace
places.blurb: Home of Hawaiʻi's last monarchs, King Kalākaua and Queen Liliʻuokalani; completed in 1882.

places.name: Michel's at the Colony Surf
places.blurb: Classic French dining on the water at the foot of Diamond Head.

places.name: Kaʻena Point
places.blurb: Oʻahu's remote western tip. A natural area reserve with nesting seabirds and Hawaiian monk seals.

places.name: Kawainui Marsh
places.blurb: Hawaiʻi's largest remaining wetland, on the edge of Kailua. Home to endangered waterbirds.

places.name: Azure
places.blurb: The Royal Hawaiian's beachfront fine-dining restaurant.

places.name: Waikīkī Aquarium
places.blurb: The second-oldest public aquarium in the US, opened in 1904.
